name: usage-bar
description: A band above the prompt: 5h and 7d rate-limit windows, session tokens and cost

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Pill colors: light or dark. The mod cannot read the app theme, so pick the one that matches.

staleMinutes.title: Fade after (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: A rate-limit reading older than this is drawn faded.

warnBelow.title: Orange at or below (%)
warnBelow.description: Percent left at which a window's bar turns orange.

dangerBelow.title: Red at or below (%)
dangerBelow.description: Percent left at which a window's bar turns red.

countCacheWrites.title: Count cache writes as input
countCacheWrites.description: On, the up arrow is uncached input plus cache writes. Off, it is uncached input alone and cache writes are counted with cache reads.
